messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain fully flexible and look forward to building a great relationship together. Let us know if this works for you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
Your rolling on-time delivery to 2026Q3 stands at 62.5% (sc:70240@2026Q3).
We can work with your lead time of 42 days.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hello,
that price is not realistic. Where does it come from?
Our terms: a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you.
A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in.
A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in.
Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are a competitive and flexible partner.
Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (3)
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. The volume change figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. Hi, we saw your note about the competing offer, but we can't match that price and keep our quality. We are sticking to our price of €33.00 for 60 days payment and 42 days lead time. We still need to see actual proof of the 4,200 pcs volume before we can consider any further steps. Our offer stays valid for 30 days. It means a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
